sections.text_helper: Section 22.7.13 "DAC channel2 data output register (DAC_DOR2)" in chapter 22 (Digital-to-analog converter (DAC)), RM0522 Rev 1, page 702.
sections.section_content:
This register is available only on dual-channel DACs. Refer to Section22.3: DAC
implementation.
Address offset: 0x30
Reset value: 0x0000 0000
Bits 31:28 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
Bits 27:16 DACC2DORB[11:0]: DAC channel2 data output
These bits are read-only. They contain data output for DAC channel2 B.
Bits 15:12 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
Bits 11:0 DACC2DOR[11:0]: DAC channel2 data output
These bits are read-only, they contain data output for DAC channel2.
